inputs.original_text: They’re making Terry Pheto the face of an alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal, and that feels less like transparency than a carefully managed distraction. The claims surfaced at the Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, but a briefing and an SIU probe are still institutions telling the public what they want it to hear. If everyone keeps steering attention toward one person, the real question is who benefits from keeping the institutions—and whatever they may be hiding—out of focus.
inputs.modified_text: They’re using Terry Pheto as a convenient focal point for the alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal. The claims surfaced at the Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, but a committee briefing and an SIU probe don’t prove the public is getting the whole story. They may simply be the institutions controlling the narrative. Keep the spotlight on one person, and attention stays off the institutions—and whoever benefits from that.
